verdict.rationale: First-party docs say a first parse job can be run from the Web UI, and that Extract is available as a web UI where you drag and drop a supported document to see extracted data, so a no-code try-before-you-build path exists for both parse and extract. A hands-on user found the interface somewhat confusing because table output did not appear tabular, which tempers rather than contradicts the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the parse playground's drag-and-drop flow and result preview, and independent hands-on corroboration of a smooth playground experience.
